The five columns REDCap's event log answers with

log_fields.Rd

Fixed here rather than derived from the answer, unlike records_frame(), and the difference is what the two are for: a register record set is whatever the project's dictionary holds today, while the log's shape belongs to REDCap and does not move with the project. Deriving it would make an empty window — the common case on a quiet night — come back with no columns at all, and every reader would then have to guard against a frame that has no username.

Usage

log_fields()

Value

A character vector of column names.
